name: inline-testimonials
title: Inline Testimonials
description: A paragraph of plain text where chosen names sit with tiny round photos and a fine underline. Hovering or focusing a name opens a small card with the person's role, quote and star rating, placed above or below the line.
use: Testimonials should sit inside a sentence and appear only when a reader shows interest.
avoid: The open card overlays neighbouring lines and there is no hover on touch, so it needs room around the text.
a11y: Names are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls, Escape closes and restores focus, ratings are labelled, and motion is skipped when reduced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Two lines of soft grey prose on a black stage, interrupted by three brighter names, each with a small round photo and a thin underline. An open quote is a compact dark card holding a larger avatar, a name, a role, a short paragraph of pale text and five tiny stars.
behaves: On a pointer device a name opens its card on hover, and keyboard focus opens it too. The card springs out from the trigger's centre with a small padded gap, waits briefly as the pointer crosses over, and shuts a moment after leaving; Escape closes it and returns focus.
customise: Give it a text string with {{id}} tokens and an array of testimonials with avatar, name, role, quote and rating; avatar size, open state and a change callback are props too.
weight: light: Two lines of text and one card that only animates on open, with measurement on demand.
